name: Morin Cloudstalker
summary: Along the eastern road from Bloodhoof Village, Morin Cloudstalker keeps watch over Mulgore. The tauren scout follows trade routes and investigates dangers to travelers.

sections.title: Watcher on the Southern Trail
sections.body: Morin Cloudstalker watches the trail east toward the Barrens. He scouts the road and guards travelers crossing Mulgore. The plains are usually peaceful, but shifting territories and busy trade routes have brought opportunists and bandits near the tauren homeland.

sections.title: Investigating the Caravan
sections.body: Morin's scouts attacked and burned a Venture Co. caravan on Stonebull Lake's northern shore. Goblin salvagers soon appeared by the wagons. So Morin sent adventurers to inspect the surviving supply crates and learn what the Venture Co. had been hauling.

sections.title: Defending Against Venture Co.
sections.body: The Venture Company has operations in Mulgore, bringing Morin a threat beyond common brigands. He sends Horde adventurers against its logging and mining outposts, including Supervisor Fizsprocket. He means to curb the damage to the sacred plains.

faq.q: Where can I find Morin Cloudstalker?
faq.answer: Morin Cloudstalker stands beside the dirt trail east of Bloodhoof Village, along the road toward the Barrens.

faq.q: What is Morin's role in Mulgore?
faq.answer: Morin watches travelers in southern Mulgore and organizes defenses against bandits and corporate intruders.

faq.q: Why is Morin investigating the ruined caravan?
faq.answer: Morin's scouts attacked and burned a Venture Co. caravan near Stonebull Lake. When goblin salvagers appeared at the wreckage, he asked adventurers to inspect the surviving crates and learn what the Venture Co. was moving.

faq.q: Why does Morin want the Venture Company stopped?
faq.answer: The Venture Company strips Mulgore's natural resources with machinery and deforestation. Morin wants its overseers stopped, including Supervisor Fizsprocket.
Morin acts for Bloodhoof Village's elders and chieftains, as well as the wider tauren leadership across Mulgore.

faq.q: Does Morin offer quests to Alliance players?
faq.answer: No. Morin is loyal to the Horde and speaks only with Horde adventurers.

angles.text: As a tauren traveling from Bloodhoof Village, you can see Morin guarding your homeland against bandits and corporate defilers.
Morin gives Horde champions an early chance to protect the supplies and sacred lands of their new tauren allies.
